49: Regarding the children of Gad and Reuven, I wrote in another place in the name of Rav Mifrashischa z"l, regarding "Mikneh Rav"(does not mean "many cattle", but instead "acquiring a teacher") that they had the property of adhesion to Moshe Rabbeinu-Peace be upon him. It might be said as well that they wanted this so that they would have the same portion as Moshe Rabbeinu himself. This is the reason that they wanted Moshe Rabbeinu to enter Eretz Yisrael, for if God were to distribute their portions to them, He would not have remained of the Canaanites, and there would have been eternal freedom. Therefore, he gave them the borders, which are the beginning of the acquisition of the land, because the borders are the extremes, the place of adhesion to the root, as it is written in the first chapter, and by this power the whole land was given to them.
